site.name: Sinan Robo
site.tagline: An auditable index of open embodied models
site.desc: A neutral model-selection layer for robot developers: which brain, where to run it, what it costs. Every field carries its source; unverified fields are labeled as such.

hero.eyebrow: Open VLA · compatibility matrix · latency & cost · every field sourced
hero.h1:
Which brain,
where to run it, at what cost.
hero.p: An auditable index of open embodied foundation models (VLA): license, weights, which robots they run on, milliseconds on which GPU, and cost per thousand inferences. Unverified fields say so. We do not guess.

kpi.pendingSub: We never fill blanks with defaults

evidence.title: Sources
evidence.empty: This record has no sources yet; every field is treated as unverified.

latency.title: Latency & cost
latency.none: No latency measurements for this model yet
latency.noneWhy: Data comes from literature, maintainer runs, or crowd CLI uploads. None exist so far.
latency.costWhy_noRent: no rental price for this hardware

list.compareHint: Tick up to 4 models, then compare

compare.title: Compare models
compare.empty: Add ?ids=model1,model2 to the URL or tick models in the index

matrix.title: Model × embodiment compatibility
matrix.p: Color is status; click a cell for evidence. Most cells start as “unknown” — we only record states we have evidence for.

hardware.title: Hardware & cost
hardware.p: Cost per 1k inferences uses the card's public reference rental price. Source and date are shown alongside.

subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.p: Model releases, license changes, new latency measurements. Only when something changed. No marketing.
subscribe.ok: Received. A confirmation email is on its way.

footer.line: Every field traceable to its source · We take no money from measured vendors

constitution.title: Why trust us
items: Rankings and recommendations contain no commercial variables
All measurement methods and raw data are downloadable
Self-hosted and third-party endpoints are shown alike
Any position with a commercial relationship is clearly labeled
